تستنقذي (form X)
# تَسْتَنْقِذِي (tastanqiḏī) /tas.tan.qi.ðiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# تُسْتَنْقَذِي (tustanqaḏī) /tus.tan.qa.ðiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
